methodology.posePolicy: Route-defined deterministic spawn; walk mode uses a 230 CSS-pixel upward pointer-look adjustment after pointer lock. No test-only camera hook or injected navigation mutation is used.
methodology.sampleDefinition: Inter-requestAnimationFrame intervals measured with performance.now() in a visible, focused local Chromium page.
methodology.fpsDefinition: frame interval sample count divided by observed elapsed run duration in seconds

environment.jsHeapMeasurement: Chromium CDP Performance.getMetrics JSHeapUsedSize sampled approximately once per second; per-run maximum is reported when supported.

caveats: No performance pass/fail threshold is imposed; these measurements describe this browser, machine, renderer, viewport and build only.
Browser hidden-page throttling or loss of focus invalidates a run and is recorded per run.
Software WebGL is flagged and must not be presented as hardware performance.
Renderer.info memory values count geometry and texture objects; asset byte totals are from exact local package files and counted once per workload by path and hash.
The browser benchmark does not measure GPU execution time or total process/GPU memory.
The real AOI remains selected_pending_coverage / not_checked; mapped feature counts do not establish completeness.
